name: apupod
description: Agent-driven local podcast studio: your agent writes hosts, plans, and scripts through MCP tools; apupod saves them, renders audio with TTS, and shows a browser UI.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, script, and render podcasts with a local studio
interface.longDescription: apupod is a local podcast studio that your agent drives through MCP tools. The agent writes hosts, plans, and scripts; apupod validates and saves them, renders audio with your TTS keys, and shows everything in a browser UI at http://127.0.0.1:4173.
defaultPrompt: Use apupod to plan a 3-episode podcast about the history of coffee.
Use apupod to write and render the script for my next episode.
